children: Arrow Financial announced Upstate Agency will acquire Skene Valley Agency, expanding its insurance footprint in Washington County.
Upstate Agency, a subsidiary of Arrow Bank, entered a definitive agreement to acquire Skene Valley Agency.
Sale is targeted to close by the end of the third quarter of 2026.
Post-closing, Skene Valley will merge into Upstate Agency to expand operations in Washington County.
Transaction aims to enhance personal and business insurance solutions and deepen local market presence.
